name: ZeroMultiplication
description: Eliminate multiplication by zero, replacing the entire expression with zero.
template_guidance: Identify Multiplication operations where one operand is 0. Replace the whole sub-tree with constant 0.

name: SubexpressionElimination
description: Extract common subexpressions that are repeated in assignments and assign them to an intermediate wire.
template_guidance: Identify repeated expression trees in assignment logic. Create a new intermediate wire assignment for the subexpression, and replace original occurrences with the intermediate wire name.

name: ConstantFolding
description: Pre-evaluate binary operations where both operands are constants or identify redundant identity operations.
pattern: C1 + C2 or A + 0 or A * 1
template_guidance: Simplify constant expressions (e.g. 5 + 3 -> 8) or identity operations (e.g. A + 0 -> A, A * 1 -> A).

name: MuxReduction
description: Simplify ternary operators and conditional cases where a constant input/control logic renders branches redundant.
pattern: Sel ? A : A or 1 ? A : B or 0 ? A : B
template_guidance: If both branches of a ternary selector are identical, replace with the branch expression. If selector is a compile-time constant, replace ternary with the active branch.

name: DeadCodeElimination
description: Remove assignments to unused variables and unreachable conditional blocks.
pattern: if (0) begin ... end or unused wires
template_guidance: Remove always/initial blocks or statements guarded by conditions that evaluate to constant false.
